artworks.title: Plate Number 683. Virginia deer, buck, galloping
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a deer in motion. The image shows a series of frames depicting a deer walking or trotting in front of a grid-lined backdrop. The frames capture different moments in the deer's gait. The background features a cage or fence with vertical lines. The lighting highlights the shadow and form of the deer's body as it moves, showcasing the fluidity and grace of its movement. The image appears to be an early motion study focused on capturing the anatomy and motion of the deer in a scientific manner.

artworks.title: Plate Number 684. Fallow deer. A: Buck and doe trotting. B: Two does trotting
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a sequential series showing two deer walking in unison. The image is composed of 16 frames arranged in a 4x4 grid, depicting the two deer walking through different stages of their gait. The frames capture the motion with slight variations in the positioning of the deer's legs, heads, and bodies as they move forward. The setting appears to be an outdoor enclosure with a dirt ground and possible barriers in the background. The images have been captured in monochrome, giving them a classic appearance consistent with early motion photography studies.

artworks.title: Plate Number 685. Fallow deer, buck and doe, trotting
artworks.description: This is a photograph of two deer walking through a wooded area. The image is a sequence of black and white frames showing the motion of two deer walking past trees and wooden structures. The top row of frames displays a larger deer with antlers in various stages of walking, followed closely by a smaller deer. The positions of the deer change slightly throughout the sequence, capturing different phases of their gait. The background consists of vertical tree trunks and a rustic wooden fence in a natural setting.

artworks.title: Plate Number 686. Fallow deer, buck and doe, galloping
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a sequence depicting two deer moving through a wooded area. The image is composed of multiple black-and-white frames laid out in a grid, capturing the motion of the deer as they walk and interact with each other.

artworks.title: Plate Number 687. Fallow deer, buck and group of does, galloping
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a sequence showing a group of deer moving. The image is a series of black and white frames depicting the movement of deer within a natural setting. The composition is arranged in a grid format, capturing the deer at various stages of walking or running. Each frame shows slight variations in the positions of the deer's legs and antlers. The setting features a dark background, which serves to accentuate the lighter tones of the deer's bodies. The grid layout suggests an analytical approach, focusing on the precise motion of the deer.

artworks.title: Plate Number 688. Fallow deer, buck and group of does, galloping
artworks.description: This is a photograph of twelve frames showing deer in motion. The frames capture different moments as the deer trot or gallop. The background is indistinct, and the deer are light in color. The scene appears to have been taken under controlled conditions.

artworks.title: Plate Number 689. Fallow deer, buck and group of does, galloping
artworks.description: This is a photograph showing a sequence of deer in motion. The image is composed of multiple frames arranged in a grid, documenting the movement of several deer running across a confined space. The frames capture different moments of their motion, displaying blurred outlines indicating speed and movement. The setting appears to be outdoors, with a background featuring a fence or barrier.

artworks.title: Plate Number 690. Fallow deer, buck and group of does, various movements
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a sequence capturing a group of deer in motion. The image is organized into a series of frames showing the deer galloping from left to right. The background is a natural setting.

artworks.title: Plate Number 692. Elk trotting
artworks.description: This photograph depicts a series of sequential images of a deer walking. The grid showcases different frames of a stag in mid-motion as it moves across a flat terrain. Each frame displays subtle variations in the deer's pose, illustrating the mechanics of its gait. The background is a simple grid, allowing a clear view of the animal's movement. The monochromatic tone gives the collection an analytical and historic feel. The composition emphasizes the elegance and grace of the stag's stride, showcasing the natural beauty of its form in motion.

artworks.title: Plate Number 693. Elk galloping
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a series of frames depicting a deer in motion. The image consists of multiple sequential black and white frames arranged in a grid, each capturing a different stage of the animal's locomotion. The frames show a deer walking or trotting, its antlers prominently visible, against a plain background. Each frame is slightly different, illustrating the nuances of movement as the deer progresses from one step to the next. The sequence focuses on understanding and capturing the flow of movement in animals. The fixed grid layout enhances the scientific observation aspect, highlighting changes in posture, leg position, and overall body dynamics.

artworks.title: Plate Number 694. Elk galloping, irregular
artworks.description: This is a series of twelve black and white frames featuring a stag in motion. The top row shows the side profile of the stag walking, while the bottom row displays the front view as it moves forward. The images capture the movement of the stag's legs and antlers in detail, depicting the dynamics of its walk. The background is consistent and resembles a controlled environment for motion study. The set evokes scientific motion studies and photography techniques from the late 19th century.

artworks.title: Plate Number 695. Elk galloping
artworks.description: This is a photograph showing a sequence of an elk in motion. The sequence captures the elk as it moves across a set path. The top row features side-on views of the elk's body in different stages of motion, while the bottom row shows rear views of the elk, displaying its antlers and body from behind. The frames are organized systematically, dividing the action into distinct phases to analyze movement.

artworks.title: Plate Number 696. Eland trotting
artworks.description: This is a series of 12 black and white frames arranged in a 4x3 grid showing a walking antelope with short, straight horns and a thin frame moving across a flat, dirt surface in a fenced enclosure. Each frame captures a different moment in the animal's gait, illustrating its motion. The photography style focuses on motion study, detailing the positioning of the creature and shadows on its body as it moves.

artworks.title: Plate Number 697. Antelope trotting
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a pronghorn antelope in motion captured through a sequence of frames. The image is in the style of Eadweard Muybridge. A series of twelve separate, sequential images in a grid show the antelope moving progressively. Each frame depicts a change in the position of the animal's legs and body, illustrating the fluid motion of its gait. The background is simple, likely a plain dark surface with vertical and horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Plate Number 698. Antelope galloping
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a sequence capturing a running antelope. The image is a series of twelve black-and-white frames showing an antelope in various stages of running. The animal is depicted with different leg positions, illustrating its galloping motion in fine detail.

artworks.title: Plate Number 699. Buffalo walking
artworks.description: This is a series of black and white frames showing a bison walking across the scene from left to right. The bison is captured in various stages of stride with its head lowered. The background is a flat, open ground with a neutral backdrop. The sequential layout resembles time-lapse imagery or early motion studies, showcasing natural animal locomotion.

artworks.title: Plate Number 701. Gnu walking
artworks.description: This is a series of black-and-white frames capturing a wildebeest walking along a fenced area. Each frame shows a different moment in the animal's stride, emphasizing its movement. The background includes a fence, suggesting a controlled environment.

artworks.title: Plate Number 702. Gnu bucking and galloping
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a series of images capturing the movement of a horned animal. The image is divided into frames that document the progression of the animal running or leaping, captured in mid-motion. The setting appears to be an enclosed area with a fenced boundary visible in the background. The ground is earthy, and the movement is presented in a way that displays the dynamics of the animal’s motion across the frames, showing different phases of its stride.

artworks.title: Plate Number 707. "Dread" galloping
artworks.description: This is a series of images capturing a dog in motion. The sequence shows the dog walking and running from side and back views. Each frame displays a different position of the dog's legs, highlighting its body movement. The background features a gridded wall possibly used as a reference point for motion analysis. The photographic style indicates a scientific approach similar to early motion photography experiments.

artworks.title: Plate Number 715. "Ike," "Maggie," etc. tugging at a towel
artworks.description: This is a photograph of two dogs playing with a cloth. The image is divided into twelve frames on a grid, showing a motion sequence of a light-colored dog and a dark-colored dog tugging on a piece of cloth. The dogs move along a track with measurements indicating distance or speed. The background is lined with a grid, enhancing the scientific or analytical feel of the series. The frames capture different stages of the interaction between the two dogs, highlighting their dynamic movement. The overall scene is monochromatic, emphasizing the contrasts between the dogs and the background grid.

artworks.title: Plate Number 721. Lion walking
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a lion walking. The image is a series of nine black and white photographs arranged in a 3x3 grid, capturing a lion in motion as it paces in an enclosure. The lion appears to be walking along the side of a barred fence or wall, showcasing different stages of its gait in each frame. The background is plain, focusing attention on the lion's muscular build and the movement demonstrated in the series. The sequence of images captures the fluidity and power of the animal as it strides forward.

artworks.title: Plate Number 722. Lion walking
artworks.description: This is a series of black and white images depicting a lion walking from left to right. The images are arranged in a sequence, showing the lion's movement across the frames. The lion's muscular body, mane, and gait are visible, showcasing the fluid motion as the lion moves. The backgrounds are consistent in each frame, emphasizing the repetitive motion and the lion's body positioning with each step.

artworks.title: Plate Number 723. Lion walking and turning around
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a lion walking within an enclosure. The image consists of a series of twelve black and white frames arranged in a grid that captures the sequential movement of a lion as it walks around a confined space. Each frame shows a slightly different position of the lion. The enclosure features a barred section and a plain wall, alongside some scattered debris on the ground. The lion's mane and body are clearly visible. The progression from left to right demonstrates an attempt to analyze or document its locomotion.

artworks.title: Plate Number 724. Lion walking and turning around
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a sequence showing a lion walking away. The image is divided into twelve panels capturing various stages of a lion moving along a narrow path. Each panel shows the lion's position shifting slightly in a time-lapse sequence documenting its movement. The setting features rough ground and wooden structures to the side.
